description: This source file defines the MimeMessageWrapper class, which provides an encapsulation around JavaMail's MimeMessage, enabling serialization, efficient access to message parts, headers, body content, and managing message attachments within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: MimeMessageWrapper
classes.description: A serializable wrapper around MimeMessage for easier management of email messages, enabling serialization/deserialization and providing access to headers, parts, content, and attachments.

classes.name: MimeMessageToString
classes.description: A converter class used to convert MimeMessageWrapper instances to String, primarily for email transmission purposes.

methods.name: setSession
methods.description: Sets the JavaMail Session object, updating internal properties.

methods.name: getSession
methods.description: Retrieves the current Session, creating a new one if necessary.

methods.name: setMessage
methods.description: Serializes and stores the provided MimeMessage, updating internal state including content type and parts count.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Deserializes and returns the stored MimeMessage object.

methods.name: getFirstHeader
methods.description: Fetches the first value of a specified header.

methods.name: getHeader
methods.description: Retrieves all values for a specified header.

methods.name: getFrom
methods.description: Returns the 'From' email addresses.

methods.name: getTo
methods.description: Returns the 'To' recipient addresses.

methods.name: getCc
methods.description: Returns the 'Cc' recipient addresses.

methods.name: getBcc
methods.description: Returns the 'Bcc' recipient addresses.

methods.name: getSubject
methods.description: Returns the email subject.

methods.name: getMessageId
methods.description: Returns the message ID.

methods.name: getSentDate
methods.description: Returns the message sent date.

methods.name: getReceivedDate
methods.description: Returns the message received date.

methods.name: getContentType
methods.description: Returns the main content type of the message.

methods.name: getMainPartCount
methods.description: Returns the number of main parts in the message.

methods.name: getSubPartCount
methods.description: Returns the number of sub-parts within a specified part index.

methods.name: getAttachmentIndexes
methods.description: Returns list of indexes corresponding to attachments.

methods.name: getMessageBody
methods.description: Constructs and returns the plain text message body.

methods.name: getMessageBodyContentType
methods.description: Determines and returns the content type of the message body.

methods.name: getMessageRawText
methods.description: Obtains the raw message content as text.

methods.name: getPartDescription
methods.description: Returns the description attribute of a specific message part.

methods.name: getPartContentType
methods.description: Returns the content type of a specific message part.

methods.name: getPartDisposition
methods.description: Returns the disposition (e.g., attachment, inline) of a message part.

methods.name: getPartFilename
methods.description: Returns the filename associated with a message part.

methods.name: getPartByteBuffer
methods.description: Returns the byte buffer content of a message part.

methods.name: getPartText
methods.description: Returns the text content of a message part.

methods.name: getPartRawText
methods.description: Returns the raw text of a message part from its input stream.

methods.name: getPart
methods.description: Retrieves a specific body part based on an index string.

methods.name: getContentText
methods.description: Extracts text from various content representations.

methods.name: getTextFromStream
methods.description: Reads and converts an InputStream into a String of text.

methods.name: getByteBufferFromStream
methods.description: Reads an InputStream into a ByteBuffer.
